section_summary.extract_value: This section details the preliminary analysis and a simple mediation analysis. Preliminary analysis involved descriptive statistics and Pearson correlations, noting a negative correlation between gratitude and loneliness, and that age was significantly associated with physical health. The mediation analysis, conducted on a sample of N=116, confirmed that loneliness significantly mediated the negative effect of gratitude on physical health, accounting for 15.7% of the variance in physical health. Subscale analysis of PHQ revealed specific mediations for sleep disturbances and gastrointestinal problems.

section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Preliminary analysis' and 'Simple mediation analysis', describes a single study's findings. It presents descriptive statistics and Pearson correlations between variables, highlighting a negative correlation between gratitude and loneliness. A mediation analysis confirmed that loneliness significantly mediates the effect of gratitude on physical health, with the model accounting for 15.7% of the variance. Age was controlled for but did not alter the results, and specific subscale analyses for physical health outcomes were also conducted.
